coverage.unsupported_reason: This legacy profile selects only InventoryOptimization/disruption_eoqd, Robotics/PIDTuning. Use frontier-eng@v1-bafa7d5 for the complete profile.

protocol.name: frontier-native-feedback
protocol.selection: best feasible combined_score over baseline and all evaluated candidate sources
protocol.final_verification: Rerun selected source as a diagnostic; retain native best-observed discovery score and record score delta or feasibility changes.
protocol.grader: Unmodified pinned native evaluator and config; stricter restricted bubblewrap namespace for PID candidate runtime.
protocol.aggregation: per task only; no suite mean or medal score
protocol.oracle: Published initial program, without optimization by a model; validates runtime and native score, not an optimum.
differences: Harbor coding-agent session rather than upstream OpenEvolve proposer loop.
600-second agent wall-clock cap in addition to the maximum100-candidate budget.
Separate Docker feedback broker; PID compatibility namespace restricted to staged inputs and Python runtime.
protocol.missing_or_invalid_submission: Native invalid verdict and sentinel retained; budget selection can retain an earlier valid design.
runtime_requirements: grader-side SYS_ADMIN plus seccomp/apparmor/systempaths unconfined; no host filesystem or Docker socket mount

coverage.note: All 47 released v1 tasks plus the separately labeled additional EngDesign aggregate. Runtime prerequisites are declared per task.

protocol.name: frontier-native-unified-feedback
protocol.selection: best feasible native combined_score observed within budget including baseline
protocol.native_evaluator_timeout_sec: Per task from the released v1 matrix: 300, 600 or 1200 seconds.
protocol.agent_wall_time_sec: Optional explicit override; default 604800-second transport timeout, with no 600-second smoke cap.
protocol.final_verification: diagnostic rerun of selected source; preserve best-observed discovery score
protocol.oracle: unchanged upstream initial program; environment reference, not optimum
differences: Harbor edits code using a separate 100-proposal feedback broker in place of the upstream OpenEvolve search loop.
The evaluator runs inside an outer namespace with hidden broker state and a read-only container root; native candidate bubblewrap processes drop capabilities.
Interpreter paths resolve to the per-task Docker runtime; original task-specific requirements and evaluation budgets are retained.
An artifact-preserving result transport avoids the optional OpenEvolve wrapper fallback; numerical metrics are unchanged.
EngDesign receives a read-only shared-helper alias in its native temporary layout; PyMOTO receives writable scratch and drops capabilities in its direct candidate subprocess.
protocol.additional_entry: EngDesign is the additional aggregate entry in the v1 matrix, separate from the 47 released v1 tasks.
protocol.result_transport: Preserve original metrics and artifacts via a dictionary wrapper; avoids optional OpenEvolve fallback that discards artifacts.

native_metadata.eval_command:
{python} verification/evaluator.py {candidate} \
--timeout-s 300 \
--metrics-out metrics.json \
--artifacts-out artifacts.json \
--stdout-out eval.stdout.txt \
--stderr-out eval.stderr.txt \
--run-meta-out run_meta.txt
